title: Network pharmacology and molecular-docking-based strategy to explore the potential mechanism of salidroside-inhibited oxidative stress in retinal ganglion cell.
authors: Zhang, Peng; Zhao, Hongxin; Xia, Xiangping; Xiao, Hua; Han, Chong; You, Zhibo; Wang, Junjie; Cao, Fang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究红景天苷抑制视网膜神经节细胞氧化应激的机制，虽涉及DNA结合转录因子和分子模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白作用而非TF-DNA互作，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Salidroside (SAL), the main component of Rhodiola rosea extract, is a flavonoid with biological activities, such as antioxidative stress, anti-inflammatory, and hypolipidemic. In this study, the potential therapeutic targets and mechanisms of SAL against oxidative stress in retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) were investigated on the basis of in-vitro experiments, network pharmacology, and molecular docking techniques. METHODS: RGC oxidative stress models were constructed, and cell activity, reactive oxygen species (ROS), and apoptosis levels were examined for differences. The genes corresponding to rhodopsin, RGCs, and oxidative stress were screened from GeneCards, TCMSP database, and an analysis platform. The intersection of the three was taken, and a Venn diagram was drawn. Protein interactions, GO functional enrichment, and KEGG pathway enrichment data were analyzed by STRING database, Cytohubba plugin, and Metascape database. The key factors in the screening pathway were validated using qRT-PCR. Finally, molecular docking prediction was performed using MOE 2019 software, molecular dynamic simulations was performed using Gromacs 2018 software. RESULTS: In the RGC oxidative stress model in vitro, the cell activity was enhanced, ROS was reduced, and apoptosis was decreased after SAL treatment. A total of 16 potential targets of oxidative stress in SAL RGCs were obtained, and the top 10 core targets were screened by network topology analysis. GO analysis showed that SAL retinal oxidative stress treatment mainly involved cellular response to stress, transcriptional regulatory complexes, and DNA-binding transcription factor binding. KEGG analysis showed that most genes were mainly enriched in multiple cancer pathways and signaling pathways in diabetic complications, nonalcoholic fatty liver, and lipid and atherosclerosis. Validation by PCR, molecular docking and molecular dynamic simulations revealed that SAL may attenuate oxidative stress and reduce apoptosis in RGCs by regulating SIRT1, NRF2, and NOS3. CONCLUSION: This study initially revealed the antioxidant therapeutic effects and molecular mechanisms of SAL on RGCs, providing a theoretical basis for subsequent studies.
abstract_zh: 背景：红景天苷（Salidroside, SAL）是红景天提取物的主要成分，一种具有抗氧化应激、抗炎和降脂等生物活性的黄酮类化合物。本研究基于体外实验、网络药理学和分子对接技术，探讨了SAL对视网膜神经节细胞（retinal ganglion cells, RGCs）氧化应激的潜在治疗靶点和机制。方法：构建RGC氧化应激模型，检测细胞活性、活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS）和凋亡水平的差异。从GeneCards、TCMSP数据库和分析平台筛选与视紫红质、RGCs及氧化应激对应的基因，取三者交集并绘制韦恩图。通过STRING数据库、Cytohubba插件和Metascape数据库分析蛋白质相互作用、GO功能富集和KEGG通路富集数据。使用qRT-PCR验证筛选通路中的关键因子。最后，利用MOE 2019软件进行分子对接预测，使用Gromacs 2018软件进行分子动力学模拟。结果：在体外RGC氧化应激模型中，SAL处理后细胞活性增强、ROS减少、凋亡降低。共获得SAL RGCs氧化应激的16个潜在靶点，并通过网络拓扑分析筛选出前10个核心靶点。GO分析显示，SAL视网膜氧化应激治疗主要涉及细胞对应激的反应、转录调控复合物和DNA结合转录因子结合。KEGG分析表明，大多数基因主要富集于多种癌症通路及糖尿病并发症、非酒精性脂肪肝、脂质和动脉粥样硬化中的信号通路。通过PCR验证、分子对接和分子动力学模拟发现，SAL可能通过调节SIRT1、NRF2和NOS3来减轻RGCs的氧化应激并减少凋亡。结论：本研究初步揭示了SAL对RGCs的抗氧化治疗效应及分子机制，为后续研究提供了理论基础。
